title: nvme/nvme-mi: decode Identify/log pages/HMB and NVMe-MI Admin responses
description:
Next MR in NVMe dissection additions.

Export the per-opcode completion decode (nvme_dissect_admin_cqe_dw0(), nvme_dissect_cqe_status(), nvme_dissect_admin_data_resp()) so NVMe-MI can reuse it, and decode Security Send/Receive (81h/82h) command dwords.

Add the missing Identify response decoders (CNS 03h/04h/12h-17h, plus 10h/11h routed to the same structures), and harden the windowed-transfer decoders NVMe-MI relies on: bound the NLBAF-driven LBA Format loop, stop the vendor-specific area underflowing its length, and fix an Identify Controller field indexed by structure offset instead of window offset.

Name the Log Page Identifier table, decode four more pages (00h/12h/13h/14h), and fix an unsigned underflow in the SMART decoder. Decode the Host Metadata structure (FID 7Dh/7Eh/7Fh) and Command Dword 11 for HMB, I/O Command Set Profile, Spinup Control, Power Loss Signaling, FDP/FDP Events, and Boot Partition Write Protection.

Fixes windowed Get Log Page / Set Features transfers (several decoders underflowed on a short window, Sanitize Status had its bail-out inverted) via a new nvme_field_in_window() helper, and registers a missing Reserved hf field in Set Features Arbitration (hf_nvme_cmd_set_features_dword11_arb\[2\]), a pre-existing bug on master unrelated to NVMe-MI.

Address additional windowed transfer issues uncovered during testing: a 64-bit LPO+offset addition that could wrap before the overflow clamp ran, four Log Page array decoders missing a record-alignment check, PLMC/HBS missing their 512-byte Reserved clamp, an FW Slot AFI field dropped on an exact 1-byte transfer, and Identify Controller CHECK_STOP_PARSE guards undersized or oversized relative to the fields they gate (Reserved1, WCTEMP, SANICAP, ANATT, ACWU -- SANICAP was also only decoding 2 of its 4 bytes).

Assisted-by: Claude

commits_data.title: nvme/nvme-mi: decode Identify/log pages/HMB and NVMe-MI Admin responses
commits_data.message:
nvme/nvme-mi: decode Identify/log pages/HMB and NVMe-MI Admin responses

Related additions to packet-nvme.c and the NVMe-MI dissectors, combined
into one commit since they build on each other and NVMe-MI's own test
coverage exercises the combination end-to-end.

Export the per-opcode completion decode (nvme_dissect_admin_cqe_dw0(),
nvme_dissect_cqe_status(), nvme_dissect_admin_data_resp()) and use it from
NVMe-MI: an Admin response previously showed its completion as three
opaque dwords and its data as a byte blob, with every response type
mislabelling the bytes after the status byte. Admin data (request and
response) is now sliced at the request's Data Offset and handed to the
shared dispatch, so Identify/Get Log Page/Get-Set Features/Security
decode the same way the PCIe/Fabrics transports do. Also decodes the MI
AE Enable List and the Security Send/Receive (81h/82h) command dwords.

Response Message error formats (bytes 3:1) are status-dependent:
Parameter Error Location (Invalid Parameter), More Processing Required
Time (MPR), Reserved (any other error), or command-specific only on
Success. These were rendered as an NMRESP unconditionally before; now
decoded once at the message level via nvme_mi_dissect_resp_status_bytes().

Request/response matching used find_or_create_conversation(), keyed on
(src, dst, srcport, dstport). Before MCTP EID assignment the host sends
from the null EID 0 while the device answers from its real EID, so
request and response landed in different conversations and every response
looked orphaned. Now keys on the physical address pair, the MCTP EID
pair, and the tag together: the tag alone repeats across peers, the EID
pair isn't stable until assignment completes, and the address pair alone
merges distinct Management Endpoints bridged behind one address (OCP
Datacenter NVMe SSD 2.7 NVMe-MI-29).

Also hardens the framing layer: keeps slotless message types (Reserved
NMIMT, Asynchronous Event Messages) out of the Command Slot lifecycle,
records the request opcode and response status in the always-run framing
layer so recovery survives a disabled body dissector, guards an IC bit on
a too-short message, verifies the MIC via proto_tree_add_checksum() with a
new check_mic preference, and flags a request that supersedes an
unanswered one on its slot.

Add the missing Identify response decoders (CNS 03h/04h/12h-17h, plus
10h/11h routed to the same structures), and harden the windowed-transfer
decoders NVMe-MI relies on: bound the NLBAF-driven LBA Format loop, stop
the vendor-specific area underflowing its length, and fix an Identify
Controller field indexed by structure offset instead of window offset.

Name the Log Page Identifier table, decode four more pages
(00h/12h/13h/14h), and fix an unsigned underflow in the SMART decoder.
Decode the Host Metadata structure (FID 7Dh/7Eh/7Fh) and Command Dword 11
for HMB, I/O Command Set Profile, Spinup Control, Power Loss Signaling,
FDP/FDP Events, and Boot Partition Write Protection.

Also fixes windowed Get Log Page / Set Features transfers (several
decoders underflowed on a short window, Sanitize Status had its bail-out
inverted) via a new nvme_field_in_window() helper, and registers a missing
Reserved hf field in Set Features Arbitration
(hf_nvme_cmd_set_features_dword11_arb[2]), a pre-existing bug on master
unrelated to NVMe-MI.

A follow-up review of the same windowed-transfer offset math found eight
more bugs: a 64-bit LPO+offset addition that could wrap before the
overflow clamp ran, Telemetry/Predictable-Latency-Aggregate/ANA poff
miscomputed at exact block boundaries or against the wrong offset, four
Log Page array decoders missing a record-alignment check, PLMC/HBS
missing their 512-byte Reserved clamp, an FW Slot AFI field dropped on an
exact 1-byte transfer, and Identify Controller CHECK_STOP_PARSE guards
undersized or oversized relative to the fields they gate (Reserved1,
WCTEMP, SANICAP, ANATT, ACWU -- SANICAP was also only decoding 2 of its 4
bytes). New regression coverage for six of the eight.

Field renames -- saved filters and coloring rules will need updating:

  nvme-mi.admin.sqe1..sqe5, .sqe10..sqe15  ->  .nsid, .cdw2, .cdw3, .mptr and
                                               the shared nvme.cmd.* CDW fields
  nvme-mi.admin.cqe1/.cqe2/.cqe3           ->  .cqe_dw0/.cqe_dw1/.cqe_dw3
  nvme-mi.admin.flags.dlen/.doff           ->  .flags.dlenv/.flags.dofstv

Assisted-by: Claude
